playstyle: Three durable Stormcast elites, each armed with both melee reach and a ranged option to threaten at multiple ranges. Five health apiece and consistent two-damage output make them reliable fighters, though single-shield saves leave them exposed to sustained pressure. Depending on the warscroll chosen, the warband either drives into enemy territory to hold treasure tokens for a mass Inspire, or anchors its own half of the board where fighters cannot be flanked and inspire by striking from home ground, winning through positional dominance either way.
